information: Version, default displayed chance, held shells, gallery rupees, wallet, Fortress/Water/Wind milestones, full eligibility and current-session active flag. No route label, event index, future receipts, owned count or RNG state. Fixed deterministic policies chosen ex ante.
class: All original policies assessed by deterministic forward occupancy, ID10000, exhaustive C7/C8 audit and bounded Tier5 extension. Choose minimum prior-mean expected time separately by region. This is best tested restricted-class route-blind benchmark, not a POMDP optimum.
labels: Synthetic analysis priors, not empirical player-route probabilities.
5_percent: Remains predeclared diagnostic under future-informed denominator; do not reinterpret as a fair matched-information threshold.
decomposition: Algebraic benchmark-minus-future-informed and policy-minus-benchmark gaps only; first mixes information and restricted-family loss, not identified pure value of information.
